nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
## Hand Tie Clips: start here

Write one shot per hop on **SCRIPT**; the node renders them in turn and joins each hop to the last.

**Links**: [GitHub](https://github.com/sandpies/ComfyUI-Hand-Tie-Clips) · [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/sandpies/ComfyUI-Hand-Tie-Clips) · the full writing guide is `PROMPTING.md` in the pack folder.

**Before you queue**
- **steps 6-8** let the audio fully resolve (the author's advice); go down to 4 only with a 4-step turbo LoRA in the LoRA loader. The DiT here is the official ref2va checkpoint, with no turbo built in. Style LoRAs go in the loader too.
- **cache_hops on**: retakes, render_from and the **TIMELINE** tab need it.
- **upsample is on** (RUN tab): after the last hop the film is sized up to `upsample_megapixels` and re-drawn. It needs the two upsample files below; turn it off for quick tests.
- Judge joins at **8 s** hops or longer.

**Models**: the files this graph loads, and the folder each goes in.

| loader | file | folder |
|---|---|---|
| DiT, and the refine / upsample DiT | [`minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensors) | `diffusion_models` |
| Text encoder | [`qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) | `text_encoders` |
| Video VAE | [`minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (or the stock [`minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)) | `vae` |
| Audio VAE | [`minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | `vae` |
| Live preview | [`taeh3`](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/blob/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors) | `vae_approx` |
| Upsample size-up (`upsample_model`) | [`minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors) (the old name `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors` also loads). Or the 2D one, [`minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_2d_conv_v1_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_2d_conv_v1/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_2d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors), which takes `sharpness` 1-6 | `latent_upscale_models` |
| Upsample re-draw (`regen2k`, the default upsample method) | [`open_h3_regenerate_2k_r256pp_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/sandpies/ComfyUI-H3-Video-Upsampler/blob/main/lora/open_h3_regenerate_2k_r256pp_bf16.safetensors) | `loras` |

**Optional files** (`models/loras`), only for the feature named:
- **Upsample method `ic`** (RUN tab → UPSAMPLE → **upsample method**; keeps faces, lettering and mouths exactly the film's own; slower): [`minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_ic_lora_avg_rank_21_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_ic_lora_avg_rank_21_bf16.safetensors) (200 MB) + [`minimax_h3_hyperflow_8step_v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/videorebirth/hyperflow/blob/main/minimax_h3_hyperflow_8step_v1.0.safetensors), and [`minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64`](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64.safetensors) if you have it. IC runs on the DiT wired to `upsample_dit`, which must be the plain [`minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensors) with no LoRAs. fl2va, pruned and merged models cannot run it; the run stops before any hop if one is wired there.
- **Upscale 2nd pass** (RUN tab): renders small, sizes up, then re-draws the texture at `2nd pass megapixels` (default 1.0 MP) in `2nd pass steps`: 2-3, to taste. Its LoRA slots are for your own LoRAs and use case.
- **SWAP tab** (one-hop person swap or scene edit from a clip): [`viggle_remake_swap_comfyui`](https://huggingface.co/Viggle/Viggle-Remake/blob/main/comfyui/viggle_remake_swap_comfyui.safetensors) and [`viggle_remake_edit_comfyui`](https://huggingface.co/Viggle/Viggle-Remake/blob/main/comfyui/viggle_remake_edit_comfyui.safetensors). The node loads the right one by itself.

**Other tabs and what they need** (full list with links: `docs/MODELS.md` in the pack folder):
- **WRITE, STANDARD (SandTie), Studio lyrics**: a local language model you run on any OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama, KoboldCpp, vLLM...), loaded with 16k+ context. Eye Scan and start-image reading need a vision model. Set it in the writer settings on WRITE.
- **RefMod Sheet -> Single Shot, Studio asset images**: one image engine (Qwen-Image 2.1 + Viggle Turbo LoRA is the lightest; MOSS-Image, MiniMax-H3-Image, P-H3-Image also work). The tab shows which it found and what is missing. Shots -> Sheet needs nothing.
- **RefMod cut-outs**: a SAM checkpoint in `models/sams`, or `pip install rembg`.
- **Studio songs**: YuE2 nodes + `yue2_3b_int8_convrot` in `checkpoints`.
- **Lip-sync `auto:vocals`, song Listen, `dialogue_lock` drafts**: HDemucs / Whisper, fetched once by hand (the pack never downloads them; commands in `docs/MODELS.md`).
- **Steering dials**: nothing to download; built on first use with `clip` wired.

**Custom node packs**: install from ComfyUI Manager or clone into `custom_nodes`.

| pack | nodes here |
|---|---|
| [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) | optional: Model Preview Override (`taeh3` live previews) |
| [ComfyUI_Nvidia_VFX_Nodes](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_Nvidia_VFX_Nodes) | optional: installs the `nvidia-vfx` package HTC Save Video's frame generation uses (RTX GPU) |

Everything else is core ComfyUI or built directly into this pack (`HTC Sparse Attention`, `H3 Token LoRA` with built-in AdaLN LoRA porting, and `H3 Cache`). Missing a pack? Delete its red node and wire around it.

- **The second Load Diffusion Model** feeds `refine_model` and `upsample_dit`: refine and upsample re-draw on a clean DiT, and `ic` needs it. It is not loaded while both are off.
- **Saving:** HTC Save Video writes the MP4. `frame_gen x2` doubles the film to 48 fps inside the save (RTX GPU + `nvidia-vfx`); `off` keeps 24 fps. Leave it `off` if you will upsample the file later.

**The MODEL chain stays drawn:** loader → HTC Sparse Attention (`native_sol_balanced`; switch to `turbo_sla_balanced` with a Turbo LoRA) → H3 Token LoRA (ships bypassed; press `Ctrl+B` to enable a LoRA with built-in AdaLN fix) → Model Preview Override → H3 Cache (ships bypassed) → this node. CLIP connects straight from the Text Encoder.

**Writing**
- One shot per hop. Later shots say only what happens next.
- Name what you want, never what you don't: the prompt only adds.
- Put `@tags` in the action where you want that reference used.
- Dialogue: one line per sentence: `@kelly says, 'Coffee's on me,' and slides a cup over.` Give the listener a closed-mouth action.
